secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Service-role key of the ASTR Supabase project (server-side reads/writes). Supabase dashboard -> Project Settings -> API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: URL of the ASTR Supabase project, e.g. https://kkwgbjovbcbzsvbhcyhq.supabase.co. Supabase dashboard -> Project Settings -> API. Overrides the sandbox default.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Publishable (anon) key of the same Supabase project — the browser client uses it. Supabase dashboard -> Project Settings -> API.

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Alpaca live API key id: market data, scans and trading. app.alpaca.markets -> API keys.

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Alpaca live API secret. app.alpaca.markets -> API keys.

secrets.name: ENGINEER_LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the engineer's OpenAI-compatible provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Anthropic-compatible, etc.). Server-side only; also add it as an ENGINEER_LLM_API_KEY secret in GitHub for the runner. Optional until the engineer is used.

secrets.name: GITHUB_ENGINEER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained GitHub PAT for the engineer: contents read/write on engineer/* branches, pull requests, and Actions dispatch. No admin rights. Optional until the engineer is used.

secrets.name: GITHUB_ENGINEER_REPO
secrets.description: Repository the engineer works on, as owner/repo. Optional until the engineer is used.
